GrocerConfig.description: The Grocer's tunables (§10). Money is decimal pounds; shares are decimals.

cash_buffer.description:
Cash it keeps in hand: it never spends (land, buildings) below this balance, so the
06:00 bills don't take it under zero by midnight (R3).

initial_order_share.description: A new shop's first order, as a share of its capacity. Above 0, at most 1.

max_bid_share.description:
The most it will pay for a lot, as a share of its bid ceiling (`balance + credit
limit`, R7). Above 0, at most 1.

min_tier_weight.description:
Tiers whose `grocer` personality weight is at least this are worth bidding on
(`tier_low: 1.0` passes, `tier_high: 0.1` does not). Between 0 and 1.

order_margin.description: Tomorrow's order = today's sales × (1 + this), capped at capacity (R2, R10). At most 1.

price_jitter.description:
Random spread either side of its price, from its own RNG stream. Below `1 −
working_class_discount`.

rescue_after.description:
From this time until midnight, a negative balance makes it sell a shop back to the
city (R5) rather than take a strike (R3). Must be after day trade closes.

shop_footprint.description: Footprint of each shop, `[width, depth]` in lot units.

shop_height.description: Height of each shop in units; capped at the type's `max_height` (R58).

shop_types.description: Day-trade shop types it builds, in rotation (`businesses.yaml` ids).

working_class_discount.description:
Working-class bias: price this far under the reference price (0.05 = 95% of
`ref_price`). At least 0, below 1.

description.description: One line on how it plays.

PersonalityWeights.description: Weights for the shared evaluation function.

risk.description: Willingness to bid high and run an overdraft.

decision_interval_ticks.description: Ticks between an AI player's decisions.

grocer.description:
How the Grocer plays (§10: "opens many cheap Low-tier shops"). Its tier choice comes
from the `grocer` personality's weights; these are its operating rules.

opponents.description: Personality ids seated by default (v1: one Grocer).

personalities.description: Personalities, keyed by id. All share one evaluation function with different weights.
